common_context.code_scope: frozen original consumer code vs local candidate; not a complete transitive runtime source snapshot (injury_duration remains a common helper)

review_follow_up.scope: Root completed the interrupted source review; the unchanged controlled 300-player replay and all original independent scenarios are reexecuted against these exact candidate hashes.
review_follow_up.duplicate_status_validation: Independent canonical duration/season/severity winner replaces permissive mixed-code membership, so ACTIVE or QUESTIONABLE cannot hide a stronger OUT/IR/RETIRED winner. Legacy duration-first winning ACTIVE remains a no-op. The old smoke selftest that explicitly exempted mixed ACTIVE/QUESTIONABLE was strengthened to accept the genuine winning badge and reject its omission.
review_follow_up.damaged_pool_identity: All recognizable aliases remain collision targets even when the containing pool row has contradictory identity fields; affected identities are locally refused rather than medically zeroed.
review_follow_up.independent_author_review_checkpoint: Original 9-case independent acceptance preceded these follow-ups; subsequent coordinator additions and reruns are not represented as a new independent-agent signoff.
